headline: Pretrained sequence models adapted to single-cell and individual-level genomic readouts
label: Sequence To Function Model Adaptation
summary: Sequence-to-function models are being fine-tuned for single-cell readouts while variant-calling and benchmarking tools mature in parallel.
synthesis: The dominant thread is adapting pretrained sequence-based models to new readouts. Scooby-2 fine-tunes AlphaGenome with a cell-specific decoder to predict single-cell RNA-seq and chromatin accessibility tracks from DNA sequence. A 3'UTR reporter screen of ~2M inserts pairs mapped regulatory elements with a context-aware deep model that prioritizes ClinVar variants. Leakage-controlled benchmarking of variant effect predictors, including a gradient-boosting consensus model, addresses how such predictors are evaluated. Representation learning over somatic missense mutations from ~50,000 tumors, along with somatic and structural variant tools (SomatiX, Verix), forms the surrounding infrastructure, alongside a xenograft reporting workflow and a multi-agent cross-cancer analysis framework. What is new is the explicit move of pretrained sequence models toward single-cell outputs.
